claims.says: The temporal.rs copy of days_from_civil, which uses truncating division for the era, gives the same day number as the value.rs copy for every year, month and day.
Given chrono's from_ymd_opt contract, a successful date-string parse yields a valid calendar date's day number, or a value chrono's ordinal-date or ISO-week parser accepted.
Every time string that parse_time_string accepts yields a second-of-day value below 86400.
For a map with distinct keys, duration(map) gives the same result as the positional seven-slot form that the binder rewrites constant map literals into.
The vector distance function returns no value exactly when the metric name (euclidean by default) is unknown or the two vectors have different lengths.
